author: Channel 5 with Andrew Callaghan
description:
To see 'Combat Obscura' or any of the 17 other documentaries currently streaming on C5.NOW while knowing that you are directly supporting independent filmmakers bringing you knowledge, perspective and entertainment, head to https://c5.now OR download the C5.NOW app on iOs, Android, Roku or Apple TV. 

Also, to see our extended Berlin 'supercut' with full interviews from Brutalismus3000, HorsegiirL, Miss Bashful and Alli Logout, head to our Patreon at https://www.patreon.com/channel5

And if you're interested in submitting a film   C5.NOW distribution, send it over to submissions@channel5.news, I check the inbox every day 
 
- Andrew Callaghan
title: Berlin Streets
